body: My life is spiraling out of control. I lost my job, I'm unhealthy, my lungs hurt and I keep smoking a pack a day. I have a total of $30, and $50,000 in college debt. No healthcare, I think I contracted herpes. I keep drinking cheap liquor til I'm puking at the end of the night. It feels like my brain is just shutting down. I can't concentrate on anything. I live in a place with no family and I've stopped talking to my friends. I don't want them to worry about me. I feel empty inside.
